title: Phemex Savings service begins
description: Phemex's December 2020 launch announcement stated that Flexible Savings and Fixed Savings would begin on 18 January 2021 as part of its Earn Crypto program.
notes: The announcement was published on 28 December 2020; the recorded event date is the stated service start date.

title: Phemex Earn terms document current Savings asset treatment
description: Updated Phemex terms explicitly documented Phemex Savings within Earn and described non-segregation, commingling, operating-use, lending, staking and exceptional return-loss risks for Earn Assets.
notes: This is a terms-update milestone, not a product failure or suspension event.

title: WhiteBIT introduces WhiteBIT Earn and renames SMART Staking to Crypto Lending
description: WhiteBIT introduced the WhiteBIT Earn product family and stated that SMART Staking would be called Crypto Lending, while saying the rename would not affect user assets.
notes: The launch_date applies to the named Crypto Lending/WhiteBIT Earn identity; SMART Staking is retained as predecessor history.

title: WhiteBIT launches flexible Crypto Lending plans
description: WhiteBIT introduced flexible Crypto Lending plans alongside fixed plans, allowing interest accrual without a fixed lock-up period and withdrawal without forfeiting already accrued flexible-plan earnings.
notes: This is a product-expansion milestone and does not imply a customer-outcome or failure state.
